displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-008: Lateral movement chain — Kerberoasting → Ticket → Service Account
description:
Detects Kerberoasting followed by TGS ticket usage to compromise service accounts

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_008", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
